9 Vector Search Techniques Every AI Engineer Should Know 🔎🧠

Vector search is much more than simply “find the nearest vector.”

At scale, different indexing, compression, and retrieval techniques help balance speed, memory, recall, and relevance.

Here’s the cheat sheet:

1️⃣ Exact / Brute-Force — highest accuracy, expensive at scale
2️⃣ ANN — approximate search for large datasets
3️⃣ HNSW — graph-based ANN
4️⃣ IVF — search selected clusters
5️⃣ IVF-PQ — clustering + compression
6️⃣ PQ — reduce vector storage
7️⃣ Binary Search — compact representations + fast distance calculations
8️⃣ Hybrid Search — semantic + keyword retrieval
9️⃣ Filtered Search — similarity + metadata constraints

💡 Key takeaway:
There isn't one “best” vector search technique.

The right choice depends on your dataset size, latency target, memory budget, recall requirements, and filtering needs.
